title: Hold an exploration licence
what: Hold an exploration licence (or other mining authorisation) from the state before prospecting or exploring for minerals.

sources.title: Mineral Resources Act 1989 (Qld)
sources.quote: 402 Offences with respect to unauthorised mining etc. (1) A person shall not— (a) enter or be upon land to carry on prospecting, exploration or mining unless the person is the holder of the relevant authority granted pursuant to this Act or is otherwise duly authorised under this Act or any other Act relating to mining;

administration.who: Queensland Department of Natural Resources and Mines (Minister)
